"""Regression corpus: each function is one case; expectations are in ../../expected.json.

No star imports here: a star import may rebind isinstance or overload, and the
analyzer is right to refuse narrowing then (LEDGER E343 correction of E327).
"""

import ast
import contextlib
import enum
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class Matcher:
    def find(self, x: str) -> int:
        return 0


class Other:
    def find(self, x: str) -> int:
        return 1


class Inner:
    def find(self, x: str) -> int:
        return 2


class WithInner:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.inner = Inner()


class Box:
    def send(self, v: object) -> None: ...


class Holder:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.matcher = Matcher()
        self.wrapped = WithInner()

    def cond_attr(self, flag: bool) -> int:
        if flag:
            self.matcher = Other()
        return self.matcher.find("a")

    def same_line_call_then_write(self, row: str) -> None:
        x = self.matcher.find(row); self.matcher = Other()

    def missing_attr_chain(self) -> int:
        return self.matcher.inner.find("a")

    def present_attr_chain(self) -> int:
        return self.wrapped.inner.find("a")


def made() -> Box:
    yield 1


def generator_annotation() -> None:
    made().send(None)


def wrap(fn):
    return lambda: 1


@wrap
def wrapped() -> Box:
    return Box()


def decorator_replaces() -> None:
    wrapped().send(None)


@contextmanager
def cm():
    yield 1


def contextmanager_send() -> None:
    cm().send(None)


def while_false(p: Path | None) -> None:
    while False:
        break
    if p is None:
        return
    p.exists()


def not_is_none(p: Path | None) -> None:
    if not p is None:
        p.exists()


def nested_and_or(p: Path | None, q: bool) -> None:
    if (p is not None and q) or (p is not None and not q):
        p.exists()


def or_list(xs: list[str] | None) -> None:
    ys = xs or []
    ys.append("a")


def case_guard_true(p: Path | None) -> None:
    match p:
        case None:
            return
        case _ if True:
            p.exists()


class Headers:
    def items(self) -> list:
        return []

    def __or__(self, other: "Headers") -> "Headers":
        return self


def binary_result(h: Headers) -> None:
    h = h | Headers()
    h.items()


class Kind(enum.Enum):
    A_B = 1


def enum_name(k: Kind) -> None:
    k.name.replace("_", " ")


def enum_value(k: Kind) -> None:
    k.value.replace("_", " ")


def path_suffix(p: Path) -> None:
    p.suffix.lstrip(".").lower()


def path_name(p: Path) -> None:
    p.name.endswith("x")


def importfrom_module(stmt: ast.ImportFrom) -> bool:
    return stmt.module.startswith("d")


def isinstance_attr_chain(x: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, Path):
        x.parent.exists()


def is_not_none_parent(p: Path | None) -> None:
    if p is not None:
        p.parent.mkdir()


def return_none_parent(p: Path | None) -> None:
    if p is None:
        return
    p.parent.mkdir()


def isinstance_importfrom(stmt: ast.stmt) -> bool:
    if isinstance(stmt, ast.ImportFrom):
        return bool(stmt.module and stmt.module.startswith("d"))
    return False


def neg_no_narrow(x: object) -> None:
    x.parent.exists()


def neg_isinstance_other(x: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, str):
        x.parent.exists()


def neg_write_after_narrow(x: object, y: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, Path):
        x = y
        x.parent.exists()


def neg_branch_write(x: object, y: object, flag: bool) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, Path):
        if flag:
            x = y
        x.parent.exists()


def neg_closure_write(x: object, y: object) -> None:
    def change() -> None:
        nonlocal x
        x = y

    if isinstance(x, Path):
        change()
        x.parent.exists()


def neg_loop_rebind(x: object, ys: list[object]) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, Path):
        for y in ys:
            x.parent.exists()
            x = y


def neg_if_without_exit(p: Path | None) -> None:
    if p is None:
        print("none")
    p.parent.mkdir()


def neg_or_narrow(x: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, Path) or x is None:
        x.parent.exists()


def neg_loop_escape(p: Path, xs: list[int]) -> None:
    q = None
    for _ in xs:
        q = p / "a"
    q.name.endswith("x")


def loop_derived_name(p: Path, xs: list[int]) -> None:
    for _ in xs:
        q = p / "a"
        q.name.endswith("x")


def walk_name(root: Path) -> None:
    for dirpath_raw, _dirs, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirpath = Path(dirpath_raw)
        for filename in sorted(filenames):
            path = dirpath / filename
            path.name.endswith("x")


def generic_branch(x: Path | list[str]) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, list):
        x[0].upper()
        x[0].exists()


def unknown_tuple_element(x) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, tuple):
        x[0].exists()


def any_dict_value(x: Any) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        x["a"].exists()


def nullable_default(headers: dict | None = None) -> None:
    h = headers or dict()
    h.items()


def neg_default_other_type(headers: dict | None = None) -> None:
    h = headers or list()
    h.items()


def any_isinstance_dict(x: Any) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        x.get("a")


def any_or_none_isinstance_dict(x: Any | None) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        x.get("a")


class Foo:
    def run(self) -> None: ...


class Bar:
    def go(self) -> None: ...


def project_union(x: Foo | Bar) -> None:
    if isinstance(x, Foo):
        x.run()


def subclass_narrowing(value: date | str) -> None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        value.date()


def neg_reassign_untyped(p: Path, other) -> None:
    q = p / "a"
    q = other
    q.exists()


def subprocess_text() -> None:
    completed = subprocess.run(["git"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    completed.stdout.strip()


def subprocess_bytes() -> None:
    completed = subprocess.run(["git"], capture_output=True)
    completed.stdout.split(b"\x00")


def parents_index(p: Path) -> None:
    p.parents[0].exists()


def sqlite_local() -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("select 1")


class Node:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.properties: dict[str, Any] = {}


def for_else_break(nodes: dict[str, Node], parts: list[str]) -> None:
    for part in parts:
        module = nodes.get(part)
        if module is not None:
            break
    else:
        return None
    module.properties.get("bindings", [])


def re_result(s: str) -> None:
    re.sub("a", "b", s).lower()


def read_text_result(p: Path) -> None:
    p.read_text().split(",")


def not_isinstance_return(v: object) -> None:
    if not isinstance(v, str):
        return
    v.strip()


def and_guard(d: dict) -> None:
    v = d.get("a")
    if isinstance(v, str) and v:
        v.upper()


def contextlib_suppress_ok() -> None:
    with contextlib.suppress(ValueError):
        pass


@dataclass
class DataNode:
    properties: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


def for_else_break_dataclass(nodes: dict[str, DataNode], parts: list[str]) -> None:
    for part in parts:
        module = nodes.get(part)
        if module is not None:
            break
    else:
        return None
    module.properties.get("bindings", [])


def for_else_break_range(nodes: dict[str, DataNode], parts: list[str]) -> None:
    for split in range(len(parts)):
        module = nodes.get(parts[split])
        if module is not None:
            break
    else:
        return None
    module.properties.get("bindings", [])
